page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top centre. Signature mark at the foot. No marginal notes on this page. The strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: oleum suâ sponte infundat; adeo uti nemo ex aulicis, ob labores, quos tu capis, quicquam sub- ire molestiæ, & contra somnum pugnando na- turæ vim inferre cogatur. Porro autem tam multiplici cognitione te imbutum audio, ut la- pidum naturas, vires radicum, & medendi fa- cultatem, non minus, quàm Solomo, aut sapien- tissimus David tenere, imò Solomonem vir- tute antecellere existimeris, &c. Hactenus. Sozomenus. QuibusTheodosiiSecundi studiis & hoc merito accensetur, quòd suâ manu libros novi Testamenti descri- psit, quorum etiam partem aliquam quo- tidie legit. Unde non alio excellentiæ aut honoris titulo Theodosium hunc com- pellat Sozomenus, quàm quòd Impera- torem literatissimum eum vocat.

Tertiò hujusmodi dedicationibus re- ges, principes, aliosq; magnates, quibus lucubrationes suas&vigilias inscripserùt, contra glifcentes suorū temporum hæ- reses, errores, & corruptelas doctrinæ sa- cræ munire, inq; veritate agnitâ confir- mare, vel labentes etiam & nutantes eri- gere animus fuit doctorib. & patribus ec- clesiasticis. Sic Gratianus ipse per literas ab Ambrosio petit de vera fide institui. Carolus M. à Bertramo presbytero petit,

page.notes: The word "glifcentes" is read with [?] doubt: the long s is printed close to an f shape. The small "Sozomenus" before "QuibusTheodosii" is set in smaller type inside the text line and is transcribed as running text. A stray dot before "psit" is a printing mark, not a note. Spacing such as "suas&vigilias" and "QuibusTheodosiiSecundi" follows the print.
